claims.speaker: Yazhi

claims.assertion: Yazhi says Evas and Adanes later merged into modern Homo sapiens, displacing a proto-Lyrian Neanderthal population.
claims.speaker: Yazhi

claims.assertion: Yazhi says conflict between Lemuria and Atlantis escalated over centuries, with Lyrian allies supporting Lemuria and Reptilian allies Atlantis.
claims.speaker: Yazhi

claims.assertion: Yazhi attributes Tiamat’s destruction and Mars surface devastation to nuclear space warfare involving flying craft.
claims.speaker: Yazhi

claims.assertion: Yazhi names Taygeteans, Engan, Arcturians, Reptilians, and Maitré among involved groups; Andromedans reportedly observed.
claims.speaker: Yazhi
